specs.name: add_section_cross_story.spec.js
specs.description: AC-11 (B10-56757 cross-story), AC-12 (no-refresh availability), AC-13 (ordering, web-scoped), AC-14 (documented as a data-migration NON-UI check, test.skip with reason), AR/RTL localization (best-effort, no locale switcher located), AC-17 regression (no duplication across perk types), consistency/casing, and the TC20 E2E happy path.

notes: Scope is web-only (Playwright, card-panel-testing) per the sibling stories' pattern. Reuse-before-build enforced: the Section dropdown ITSELF is the same live control B10-56729 already selectored (mat-select[formcontrolname="section_id"]) — this story only adds the '+ Add section' MODAL, which is genuinely new page-object surface. All new selectors were captured by actually driving the browser (Playwright MCP) against card-panel-testing 2026-07-16, not inferred from Figma — see ac-coverage-matrix.md 'Live findings' for every confirmed deviation from the AC/CSV wording and Figma assumptions (modal title/label casing, no distinct X icon, shared non-field-highlighted duplicate error, AR-required resolution, live seeded-section data of only Breadfast + General Purchases, no character cap on the Section name). AC-14 is explicitly NOT automated as a fake UI test — it is a data-migration check requiring DB/API access not available in this Playwright-only run. Execution surfaced one real, reproducible environment nuance (not a test bug): a newly-created Section's visibility when switching to a DIFFERENT perk type within the SAME SPA session is intermittent (network capture showed some perk-type switches don't reissue a section/list fetch) — see the dated finding in add_section_cross_story.spec.js and ac-coverage-matrix.md; this affects AC-12's cross-type generality and AC-17's regression check and is reported honestly rather than hidden.
